description: This file defines various placement attribute classes used in Orleans for specifying placement policies for grains, including attributes for random, hash-based, local preference, activation count-based, silo role-based, resource optimized, and immovable placement strategies.

classes.name: PlacementAttribute
classes.description: Abstract base class for all placement policy marker attributes, holding a placement strategy and providing a method to populate grain properties.

classes.name: RandomPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses the RandomPlacement policy; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses the HashBasedPlacement policy; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: PreferLocalPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain prefers local placement; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses activation count-based placement policy; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses silo role-based placement policy; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating the grain uses resource-optimized placement policy; defaults to singleton instance.

classes.name: ImmovableAttribute
classes.description: Attribute that marks a grain as immovable, preventing automatic migration; includes a kind parameter.

classes.name: ImmovableKind
classes.description: Flags enum specifying the scope of immovability, such as repartitioner, rebalancer, or both.

methods.name: PlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placement strategy, and a method to populate grain properties.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to populate grain properties with placement strategy data.

methods.name: RandomPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of RandomPlacement.

methods.name: HashBasedPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of HashBasedPlacement.

methods.name: PreferLocalPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of PreferLocalPlacement.

methods.name: ActivationCountBasedPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of ActivationCountBasedPlacement.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of SiloRoleBasedPlacement.

methods.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the placement strategy to singleton instance of ResourceOptimizedPlacement.

methods.name: ImmovableAttribute
methods.description: Constructor with optional kind parameter, marks a grain as immovable and populates properties accordingly.
